history.summary: Tiny 22-unit 2005 freehold walk-up apartment in Hougang with only ~10 lifetime sale transactions. The algo's cheap read rests on a single comparable (psf_cohort_txns=1) — a data quirk, not a bargain — and the asset is structurally illiquid.
history.rating_rationale: Web check confirms Treasure Gardens is a 22-unit freehold completed 2005 (Teow Hock Ave, Hougang) with only ~10 sale transactions in its ENTIRE history and 38 lifetime rentals. The algo's -12.2% age-adj-cheap and 7.3% psf-vs-cohort are computed off psf_cohort_txns=1 and appreciation_txns=5 — essentially noise; per v3.4 priors a big premium on 1-2 comparables is a data quirk and must be discounted hard. The 'very_old_property' flag is real (21 yrs). At $1,308 psf for a 581 sqft old unit there's no verified, structural cheapness, and a near-dead resale market means real exit risk over a 5-7yr hold. Freehold is not a forward edge. Honest Avoid.
